SELECT
    (SELECT json_group_object(purpose, n)
     FROM (
         SELECT quote(t.k_symbol) AS purpose, COUNT(*) AS n
         FROM main.trans AS t
         GROUP BY t.k_symbol
     )) AS purpose_values,
    (SELECT json_group_array(role)
     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d.type AS role FROM main.disp AS d)) AS disposition_types,
    (SELECT json_group_array(gender)
     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.gender FROM main.client AS c)) AS genders,
    (SELECT MIN(c.birth_date) FROM main.client AS c) AS earliest_birth,
    (SELECT MAX(c.birth_date) FROM main.client AS c) AS latest_birth

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM main.trans AS t
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(t.k_symbol), '') IS NULL
  AND t.account_id IN (
      SELECT d.account_id
      FROM main.disp AS d
      JOIN main.client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
      WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
        AND c.gender = 'M'
        AND c.birth_date >= '1974-01-01'
        AND c.birth_date < '1977-01-01'
  )
LIMIT 1
